description: Cold-chain logistics: LTE/NB-IoT tracker, ESP32/ARM, temperature monitoring for perishable goods. Critical compliance required.

availability.title: Cold-chain tracker unavailable — CRITICAL
diagnosisSteps: Review mesh observability for last delegation
Check if device entered degraded mode
mitigationSteps: Switch to offline mode with last-known GPS
availability.escalationTrigger: ALWAYS escalate cold-chain unavailability immediately — cargo spoilage risk.

responseTime.title: Cold-chain response time degraded
responseTime.escalationTrigger: If response time >10s and temperature is in warning zone, escalate immediately.

dataLoss.title: Cold-chain data loss — CRITICAL
symptoms: Outbox pending >0 (any pending event is a breach)
mitigationSteps: Switch to higher-frequency sync if network available
dataLoss.escalationTrigger: ANY data loss in cold-chain is a compliance event — escalate to compliance officer.

recoveryTime.title: Cold-chain recovery time exceeded
recoveryTime.escalationTrigger: If recovery >10 min, escalate to logistics coordinator.

cost.title: Cold-chain daily cost budget exceeded
cost.escalationTrigger: If cost consistently exceeds budget, escalate to operations.
